find_package(libssh2 CONFIG REQUIRED)

set(SOURCES
    ClientMode.cpp
    Connection.cpp
    ConnectionFromClient.cpp
    Identity.cpp
    KnownHosts.cpp
    Service.cpp
)

# Generated by compile_ipc() in Libraries/LibSSHWebClient/CMakeLists.txt.
# We re-declare them here so this target depends on the codegen step too.
set(GENERATED_SOURCES
    SSHWebClientEndpoint.h
    SSHWebServerEndpoint.h
)

add_library(sshwebservice STATIC ${SOURCES} ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
ladybird_generated_sources(sshwebservice)
target_include_directories(sshwebservice PRIVATE ${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR})
target_include_directories(sshwebservice PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/../..)
target_include_directories(sshwebservice PRIVATE ${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Services/)
target_link_libraries(sshwebservice PUBLIC
    LibCore
    LibFileSystem
    LibIPC
    LibMain
    LibSSHWeb
    LibThreading
    LibURL
    libssh2::libssh2
)

add_executable(SSHWebServer main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SSHWebServer PRIVATE sshwebservice)
